thread:
lia_ux: Quick UX ping: in-product help panel links don't produce URL fragments, so shared links don't land on the right section. Users expected direct anchors.
tom_eng: Repro on latest prod. The panel is an overlay so we intentionally avoided pushState, but agree we need deep-linking.
rachel_docs: Docs use ids like #response-format. The panel headings sometimes use different words (e.g., "Output Format") which makes anchors fragile.
devqa: Important QA note: when opening overlay via fragment, focus must move into the overlay and the heading must be announced. Also test back button behavior.
tom_eng: Proposed quick fix: 1) add data-anchor attr to help triggers, 2) on open call history.pushState with the fragment and focus the element in overlay, 3) fallback to ?help=anchor parsing on load. Estimate: 1d dev + small a11y tweaks.
lia_ux: Copy alignment: prefer short label "Docs" in the UI, and ensure heading text in docs includes the canonical id in parentheses for clarity. rachel_docs will add redirects for legacy anchors.
rachel_docs: I'll push a docs PR with stable ids and an alias table mapping UI labels -> doc ids. Will add redirect rules for existing anchors.
build-bot: CI status: docs PR queued, no deploy yet.
tom_eng: I'll include aria-controls/aria-expanded on triggers and a focus trap in the overlay. I'll tag UX, Docs, and QA on the PR.
lia_ux: Thanks — if we can scope the minimal set (fragment + aria attrs + focus behavior) that's ideal for next sprint.
devqa: Also add a tiny visual hint: tooltip "Opens Docs — jumps to section" so users know the link behavior.
lia_ux: Good call. Thanks everyone.
